# [TASK] Contract testing with Spring Cloud Contract (gateway ↔ movie-service)

## Task
Add Spring Cloud Contract for the internal gateway <-> movie-service boundary (ADR-008, ARCHITECTURE.md §10.6).

## Parent Story
Parent: #97

## Scope
- TMDB-side tests stay fixture-based (ADR-008).
- actor-service contract coverage is saved for future iterations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] movie-service has at least one Spring Cloud Contract contract (`shouldReturnMovieById.groovy`) for a facade endpoint the gateway routes to, and `./gradlew :backend:movie-service:build` publishes a stub jar from it
- [x] api-gateway consumes that stub jar via StubRunner in `MovieServiceContractTest`
- [x] An intentional breaking change to the contracted response fails movie-service's build, not just a downstream gateway test
- [x] `./gradlew :backend:movie-service:build :backend:api-gateway:test` is green with the new setup

## Estimate
**Hours:** 8

## Notes
- Contract file defined at `backend/movie-service/src/contractTest/resources/contracts/movie/shouldReturnMovieById.groovy`.
- `BaseContractTest.java` implemented at `backend/movie-service/src/test/java/com/filmpire/movie/contract/BaseContractTest.java`.
- `MovieServiceContractTest.java` implemented at `backend/api-gateway/src/test/java/com/filmpire/gateway/contract/MovieServiceContractTest.java`.
